topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes, connects the material to earlier histopathology practicals, and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Discovery of oncogenes through tumor virology and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: They trace how the historical study of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to measure cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and genetics of oncogenes and tumor suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: They define the functional classes of cancer genes and illustrate how mutation types and allele dosage govern oncogene and tumor suppressor behavior.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the repair, replication, and mitotic defects that drive sequence and chromosomal instability, as well as the resulting cellular stresses.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how the stepwise accumulation of somatic and inherited mutations accelerates tumor progression and shapes clinical cancer syndromes.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture, offers recommended reading, and looks ahead to the next session.
